_comment: Canonical AUTHORING palette. Every generated sprite is quantized into these 16 slots and imported with importSprite.mjs --palette. It is NOT a look — it is the slot contract. All in-game variety (race, gear tier, rarity, elite, prismatic) comes from src/render/palettes.ts recoloring these slots at runtime. Values mirror BASE_UNIT in src/render/palettes.ts so authored art previews in the game's default look.

skin.meaning: exposed flesh: face, hands, any bare limb. Race swaps this ramp.

primary.meaning: dominant worn material: leathers, robe body, hide, carapace. Gear tier drives this.

secondary.meaning: supporting material: cloth, straps, lining, under-layer. Gear tier drives this too.

accent.meaning: metal and trim ONLY — buckles, blade, rivets, gem. RESERVED as the rarity-signal channel; keep its pixel count small and deliberate.

rules: Within a group, slot index ascends dark -> light. Never break the ramp ordering; the recolor system assumes it.
Accent (13-15) is the rarity channel. If a unit floods it, every rarity tier looks the same. Budget roughly 3-8% of opaque pixels.
Slot 0 is transparent and never carries color. Alpha is binary — no partial alpha survives the pipeline.
A sprite that uses colors outside these groups still imports, but it cannot be recolored, so it cannot become a SKU.
